# Language resource attribution

The bundled language pack contains selected and converted material from:

- **Open English WordNet, 2025 edition**, by the Open English WordNet team. CC BY 4.0; the included Princeton material retains its original license. Selection, JSON conversion, and links to the application concepts are modifications. See [Open English WordNet license](Open-English-WordNet-LICENSE.md) and [Princeton WordNet license](Princeton-WordNet-LICENSE.txt).
- **VerbNet 3.4**, University of Colorado. See [VerbNet license](VerbNet-3.X-LICENSE.txt). Citation: Karin Kipper, Anna Korhonen, Neville Ryant, Martha Palmer, *A Large-scale Classification of English Verbs*, Language Resources and Evaluation 42(1), 21–40, 2008. The conversion selects classes, preserves frame trees, and adds deterministic frame locators and application concept mappings.
- **Grammatical Framework and its Resource Grammar Library**: the compiled grammar and runtime notices are in [GF](../gf/GF-LICENSE.txt), [RGL](../gf/RGL-LICENSE.txt), and [application grammar](../gf/APP-LICENSE.txt). Exact build sources are in [sources.json](../gf/sources.json).

[Conversion manifest and source hashes](../data/source-manifest.json). These resources contribute lexical candidates and grammatical constructions. They do not supply Solarpolis facts or unrestricted conversation.
